title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting and call transcripts through MCP
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents live transcripts through the Work IQ MCP server, contrary to the briefing's documentation gaps. The developer guide explicitly requires WorkIQ access and an MCP policy that allows subscription operations, and describes the capability as public preview.

claims.claim: The roadmap requires applicable permissions and consent but names none.
claims.quote: requires applicable permissions and consent
claims.fix: Replace the fourth Open questions bullet with: "The public-preview developer guide specifies the Work IQ delegated permission WorkIQAgent.Ask and requires admin consent for live-transcript access through MCP." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/real-time-transcripts#prerequisites, which says "Add the Work IQ delegated permission WorkIQAgent.Ask" and "Grant admin consent for the permission." The roadmap's omission is accurate, but presenting the permission as an unanswered question is misleading now.
